_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. An override for the registry's in-app narrative course.title — the registry title reads as a chapter name in the app ('Delta Lake & Unity Catalog Foundations'), while these are search-facing and lead with the concept so a viewer scanning YouTube sees what the video is about first. Read by gen-descriptions.mjs (headline + series list) and thumb.mjs (panel header).
